# Sleep Tracker · Pixel Bar Chart

An offline browser app to track hours slept over 7 days. Enter hours (0–12) for each day, and see a pixel-style bar chart update live. The weekly average is shown to one decimal, and the longest night is highlighted in gold.

## Features

- Seven number inputs (one per day) with clamping to 0–12.
- Canvas-based pixel bar chart with grid lines and labels.
- Weekly average displayed to one decimal place.
- Longest night highlighted in gold and listed below the chart.
- Keyboard-accessible labeled controls.
- Responsive layout (works from 360px wide).
- No external dependencies or network requests.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Adjust the input values to see the chart and statistics update instantly.

## Files

- `index.html` – main page structure.
- `styles.css` – styling and layout.
- `app.js` – logic for inputs, chart drawing, and statistics.
